about_the_game:
🕹️ About the Game

PolyCrime is a deep, sandbox-style crime simulator set in a reactive open world full of risk, reward, and relentless ambition. Start as a small-time hustler and rise through the criminal ranks — or take the legal route to power. Grow your empire your way in a city that never sleeps, and where every choice has lasting consequences. Play solo or team up with friends in full Steam Co-op. Cooperate to dominate the underworld — or sabotage each other in a cutthroat race to the top.

🎯 Key Features

🔫 Realistic Drug & Weapon Economy

Grow, manufacture, smuggle, trade, or negotiate — every gram, bullet, and dollar counts. Optimize your supply chains and maximize profit, legally or otherwise.

🌆 Living, Breathing City

Explore a dynamic city where NPCs have memories, relationships, and motivations. Gain allies, make enemies, bribe officials, or get ratted out — no two playthroughs are the same.

🚓 Cops, Gangs & Corruption

Stay ahead of police patrols, strike deals with gangs, or manipulate evidence to avoid conviction. Use bribes or favors to turn the justice system to your advantage.

💼 Invest, Work & Grow Legally

Buy and operate shops, restaurants, and other businesses. Take on city jobs, save up, and build wealth — or use it all as a front to launder your dirty money.

🏢 Empire-Building from the Ground Up

Purchase properties, upgrade stash houses, hire dealers or enforcers, and take control of entire city blocks. From back alley deals to political influence — your empire is what you make it.

🌱 Genetic Weed Cultivation

Grow, breed, and experiment with cannabis genetics. Create high-value strains with unique effects, appearances, THC/CBD levels, and yields. (Weed is just one part of a vast system.)

🎭 Reputation & Status System

Earn fear, loyalty, or respect. Your standing with gangs, police, civilians, and business partners changes based on your actions — and it will come back to you.

🎰 Nightlife & Casino

Spend your hard-earned money in the city’s vibrant nightclub scene or try your luck at the casino. Relax, socialize, or fun — the city never sleeps.

🏆 Global Multiplayer Events

Take part in competitive multiplayer events where players across the world can compete for exclusive rewards. From high-stakes races to crime-themed challenges — only the bold will win.

🌐 Advanced Darkweb Multiplayer Systems

💻 Hack Bank Accounts – Infiltrate other players’ digital wallets and drain their hard-earned cash.

🚓 Trigger DEA Raids – Send a federal raid to a rival’s stash house or grow op.

🔪 Hire Assassins – Send cold, calculated killers after your enemies.

⚔️ PvP World Invasions – Gain access to enemy cities and dominate in real-time.

💡 Summary

PolyCrime offers a deep, replayable simulation of city crime, survival, and strategy. With dynamic systems, emergent gameplay, and multiple progression paths — legal or illegal — your story is yours to write.

Will you become a feared kingpin, a respected entrepreneur, or just another name lost to the streets?

⚠️ Disclaimer

FoxGameDev Studio does not endorse or promote real-life violence, crime, drug use, or illegal behavior.

All content is fictional and intended for mature, responsible audiences.

The game encourages player choice and freedom within a stylized simulation world.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains adult themes including drug production, trafficking, and usage. It features strong language, criminal activities such as illegal trade and gun violence, and depictions of police chases and arrests. Some NPCs may react to drug deals by alerting authorities.

Player choices may include morally ambiguous or illegal actions, such as bribery, money laundering, and gang warfare.

There are no depictions of sexual content, rape, or non-consensual acts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
